messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

messages.user:
ASSAY TYPE: Indirect ELISA

REAGENTS:
- Antigen
- Blocking Buffer
- Primary Antibody
- Labeled Secondary Antibody
- Wash Buffer
- Substrate

messages.assistant:
module fluorescence

manifest Antigen
manifest BlockingBuffer
manifest PrimaryAntibody
manifest LabeledSecondaryAntibody
manifest WashBuffer
manifest Substrate

instructions:

antigen = dispense 100 units of Antigen
heat antigen at 4c for 720m

blocker = dispense 200 units of BlockingBuffer
blocked = mix antigen with blocker for 5s
heat blocked at 25c for 60m

wash1 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp1 = mix blocked with wash1 for 30s
dispose temp1

wash2 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp2 = mix blocked with wash2 for 30s
dispose temp2

wash3 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp3 = mix blocked with wash3 for 30s
dispose temp3

primab = dispense 100 units of PrimaryAntibody
primed = mix blocked with primab for 5s
heat primed at 37c for 60m

wash4 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp4 = mix primed with wash4 for 30s
dispose temp4

wash5 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp5 = mix primed with wash5 for 30s
dispose temp5

wash6 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp6 = mix primed with wash6 for 30s
dispose temp6

secab = dispense 100 units of LabeledSecondaryAntibody
complex = mix primed with secab for 5s
heat complex at 37c for 60m

wash7 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp7 = mix complex with wash7 for 30s
dispose temp7

wash8 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp8 = mix complex with wash8 for 30s
dispose temp8

wash9 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp9 = mix complex with wash9 for 30s
dispose temp9

sub = dispense 100 units of Substrate
reaction = mix complex with sub for 5s
heat reaction at 25c for 15m

signal = detect fluorescence on reaction for 10s

if (signal >= 1) {
    dispose reaction
}

dispose reaction
